import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    q = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    adj = [set() for _ in range(n + 1)]
    isolated = n
    out = []
    for _ in range(q):
        t = data[idx]; idx += 1
        if t == b'1':
            u = int(data[idx]); v = int(data[idx + 1]); idx += 2
            if len(adj[u]) == 0:
                isolated -= 1
            if len(adj[v]) == 0:
                isolated -= 1
            adj[u].add(v)
            adj[v].add(u)
        else:
            v = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
            if adj[v]:
                for w in adj[v]:
                    s = adj[w]
                    s.discard(v)
                    if not s:
                        isolated += 1
                adj[v].clear()
                isolated += 1
        out.append(isolated)
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(map(str, out)) + "\n")

    n = int(data[0])

    adj = [set() for _ in range(n + 1)]
    deg = [0] * (n + 1)
    isolated = n
    out = []

        out.append(isolated)
